design: Three atomic facets over one previously exposed source document, followed by exact-handle union and host composition. Linked calls remain one source cluster.

priorExposure.observed: Compound query abstained; lifecycle query selected and exact-fetched L39; context-budget/alias/caveat query abstained although the section and relevant blocks appeared in search results.
priorExposure.implication: This is informed diagnostic iteration, not holdout or independent replication.

questions.facetA: Which roots were selected despite no publication/persistence requirement?
questions.facetB: Which exact context-budget numbers were measured?
questions.facetC: Which owner aliases appeared, and is primary causality established?

primaryMetrics: Jev selection/abstention for each atomic query
exact frozen-source fetch and returned fingerprint
verbatim evidence-pack validation for selected handles
union coverage of only selected and validated ranges
host-authored paragraph support and explicit causal caveat

blindReview.input: anonymized atomic queries, selected literal evidence, exact union pack and host-authored paragraph; omit identifiers, labels, scores, status and source path

independentUnit: one previously exposed source-document cluster; linked query results are not independent samples

minimumSupport.interpretation: reporting floor; this three-query single-cluster follow-up is descriptive only

uncertaintyMethod: raw counts only; no inference or calibration
unionPolicy: Use only handles Jev selected and exact fetch validated. Build the union through the read-only evidence-pack module. If any facet is missing, state the composition is incomplete and do not substitute a target range.
hostCompositionConstraints: compose only from exact ranges selected and fetched in this run
preserve a citation for each included line range
state duplicate aliases are worth investigating but are not established as the primary cause
Jev chooses evidence; the host writes the paragraph
